entries.23795c1f7ad61985: This category produces and sells anime and game related merchandise and online lottery services. The online lottery services "Marukuji" and "Kujicolle" are lottery services that can be purchased over the internet. No amount is disclosed separately.
entries.2a27559c55a7829c: This is a category that plans, develops and sells console games. The consolidated subsidiary ZERO DIV Co., Ltd. is responsible for planning and development of console games, and is releasing original titles for the Nintendo Switch, reissuing retro game titles, and licensing out to overseas markets. There is no separate disclosure of amounts.
entries.30c31f442e980eca: This business uses content IP (intellectual property such as characters) arising from the wide range of services held across the group to deploy cross-media in Japan and overseas into various entertainment fields, with a diverse service lineup including games, manga, anime, merchandise and online lotteries. Sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥2,177 million, and the online lottery services "Marukuji" and "Kujicolle" drove results through the continued acquisition of popular IP and the growth of titles aimed at women. From this fiscal year, it has also started an anime business through investment in production committees.

entries.f2873c87954ec1c5: This business produces many light novels and comics, and publishes print books and sells e-books. The consolidated subsidiary Hifumi Shobo Co., Ltd. (100.0% of voting rights) is in charge, and it runs the comic brands "Polca Comics", "Comic Nova", "Lawale Comics" and "Bianco Comics", and the novel brands "Saga Forest", "Orgis Novel", "Brave Bunko" and "Hifumi Bunko", among others. Sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥2,482 million; although the number of titles fell below the previous year, average sales per title rose, and e-books in particular performed well.
